Hi Alyssa — thanks for the sample and the clear options. Short answer: we prefer SFTP dropbox for vendor invoices (automated ingestion + PO matching), but we do accept emailed invoices as a fallback for the first one while SFTP onboarding completes.

Details:
- PO policy: we match to POs when a PO number is present in a machine-readable field (invoice line or designated PO field). PO on a scanned PDF header or handwritten is unreliable.
- Filename: PO_<PO#>_<VendorShort>_<YYYYMMDD>_INV is ideal — e.g. PO_87294_MAVEN_20270621_INV.pdf. If no PO, use VENDOR_<YYYYMMDD>_INV.
- PDF layout: please ensure line items are in a table (columns: qty, description, unit, unit price, line total) — avoid merging PO into header text. See attached sample for our mapper.
- SFTP: we’ll provide credentials after you fill the secure onboarding request form (link below). We can fast-track if you reply with the vendor tax ID and billing contact.

Attachments and links:
- SFTP onboarding form: https://secure.redwood-inference.com/onboarding/sftp-credentials-request
- Example mapping: attached as SFTP_config_instructions.pdf (small instruction stub)

If you’d like, we can accept this first invoice via billing@redwood-inference.com now and move the rest to SFTP after onboarding. Marissa — can you confirm we can accept a one-off emailed PDF while SFTP is being set up?

Thanks,
